name: Donny's Boat Rentals & Marina
primary_cta: Send to Taylor on WhatsApp (prefilled from the rental planner)
brand_truth: The family dock at the end of Black Sound, Green Turtle Cay, where Donny lives on site and four 4-stroke boats wait for guests staying on the cay.
buyer: Visitors staying on Green Turtle Cay (US families and couples, on a phone, the week before or the day of) choosing a boat; secondary: cruisers checking dockage.

direction.type: T11 Neo-grotesk display (Bricolage Grotesque + Figtree, self-hosted)
direction.why: The buyer is choosing between four boats, so the fleet sliding sideways is the decision itself; shallow-flats aqua is the water in their own photos; a friendly contemporary grotesk suits a family rental business and differs from the serif luxury marinas in the repo.

tier_reason: Small family rental fleet: their own photographs carry it. The hero is a living photograph (2.5D depth + water shimmer, three.js lazy-loaded), no real-time 3D scene.
concept_type: brochure + rental enquiry: fleet track, cost planner to WhatsApp/email, marina page with rates and slip check

current_site_findings: Wix site, copyright 2020, still opens with a Covid entry link
Dockage and Activities View More buttons reload the homepage
Book Now buttons are bare mailto links; WhatsApp number not on the site
No way to work out what a multi-day rental costs
pitch_line: Your four boats side by side with real prices, a planner that adds up the days and sends Taylor a ready WhatsApp request, and your marina aerial alive on the first screen.
assumptions: Prices and terms current as published on donnysboatrentalsgtc.com (fleet and dockage pages, read 2026-11-20)
WhatsApp to Taylor (242 815 9323, from noonsite) is the right booking channel
Multi-week estimate = whole weeks at the 7-day price plus remaining days at the day price (derived, labelled as estimate)
Whether the $100 deposit is part of or on top of the rental price is not stated; copy keeps it neutral
Photo-to-boat mapping follows page position and alt text on their fleet page
notes: Fix pass 1 applied, awaiting independent critic re-score. Changes: the day is the hero (headline: Collect your boat at 8, island-hop all day, back by 5. From $125 a day, the lowest published day rate) with an 8 am to 5 pm time rail across the first screen that jumps to each chapter; sharp Whaler-at-the-dock photo in a split hero with the type on plain ground; the dock chapter is now a pinned stage with a scroll-driven clock rail, text vertically centred beside each photo, no ghosted headings or empty column; fleet heading moved out of the pinned frame, consistent crops per boat, prices in Figtree tabular figures, the 19 ft Whaler near-duplicate photo removed; planner total card sits at the top beside the heading and boat picker; the burned-in yellow labels are cropped out of the annotated aerial, with a typed caption; home marina teaser uses the clean marina aerial; the concept tag is lifted with --concept-offset only while the phone WhatsApp button shows; headlines made specific.
